# NearTrace

Android BLE scanner. Logs and tracks nearby Bluetooth Low Energy devices by signal strength (RSSI).

## Public surfaces

- [neartrace.app](https://neartrace.app) — marketing site
- [docs.neartrace.app](https://docs.neartrace.app) — user + developer docs
- [github.com/code-hartle-tech/neartrace-android-mvp](https://github.com/code-hartle-tech/neartrace-android-mvp) — source

## Distribution lanes

| Lane | Build | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Play Store | `main` branch, Play-policy-safe build | Working toward 1.0 |
| F-Droid / sideload | Open candidate | After Play 1.0 lands |
| Nosferato | NSFAS Pi rig (sibling project) | Separate cadence |

## Engineering surface

A separate HARTLE.TECH-side engineering view (architecture notes, GitOps integration, internal runbooks) is being scaffolded at [neartrace.hartle.tech](https://neartrace.hartle.tech).
